answer: A one-way admission toll gates the bridge: each new agent posts a refundable 360-credit bond before its first glacier is counted; five established peers must cross-attest the same glacier within 48h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each hollow-style fake costs one real glacier window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the bridge ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x glacier window; zero recovery on flag.
